test_title: PYST 3: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked as Ant, Bat, Cat, Dog, Egg, Fog. Select the word that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'Dog'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/831b5f29bdee49b0dc30da65f2e62833d197952a7d6e0373e38a02aa3fda3cc6.png]
solution:
**Given :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/831b5f29bdee49b0dc30da65f2e62833d197952a7d6e0373e38a02aa3fda3cc6.png] 

**Bat and Ant are common in both dices. So, remaining two will be opposite face.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b95ad4b119232d09fde27b9f38b39603648953cddc4828c679ef0324b2fe7023.png] 

From the both dices :

 
 

 
 
Dice 1

 
 
 
Ant

 
 
 
Bat

 
 
 
**Dog**

 
 
 

 
 
Dice 2

 
 
 
Bat

 
 
 
Ant

 
 
 
**Fog**

 
 
 

 

Thus, Dog opposite to Fog

Hence,** Fog **is the **correct answer.**
